text: The purpose of this report is to recommend amending the Rules of Procedure for the hearings of the Property Standards Committee to make electronic participation a permanent option for electronic meetings and hearings.

The Property Standards Committee adopted the following amendment to the Property Standards Committee Rules of Procedure: 1. Deleted Rule 12 E.1.1 and replaced it with the following: a. An electronic meeting shall comply with the Building Code Act, 1992 and the electronic meeting requirements adopted by the Committee; and b. An electronic hearing shall comply with the Building Code Act, 1992, the Statutory Powers Procedure Act and the electronic meeting requirements adopted by the Committee.
